summary: Iteration 11: tested the boot watchdog, iPad/PWA icons, the NavdeckLink.exe download, the SimLinkPanel FSUIPC7 steps, a bridge regression using the saved token, and ATC direct delete/restore. Backend/static: 12/12 pytest passed. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Found one real bug: if the bundle boots after more than 10s, the fallback screen stays on the page.

minor.issue: Returns 200 text/html (the SPA index.html), not 404. This is acceptable because the Python script itself is gone.

ui_bugs.issue: Slow boot leaves the fallback visible. Reproduced by delaying bundle.js 13s: the app renders (window.__navdeckBooted=true) but #boot-fallback stays display:grid. Its min-height is 100vh and it sits under #root, so a full 'NAVDECK didn't start' screen appears below the app (visible on scroll). It also sends a false 'App bundle did not boot within 10s' beacon. This is likely on slow iPad/cellular connections. Fix: in src/index.js after setting __navdeckBooted, add `document.getElementById('boot-fallback')?.style.setProperty('display','none')`, or have the watchdog keep polling and hide it.

issues: At 1920px the 'Disconnect' button wraps onto its own row under Download and New connection code, because the panel column is narrow. This is cosmetic.

action_items: Hide #boot-fallback when the bundle boots late (src/index.js). Also consider skipping the beacon if __navdeckBooted gets set later.
critical_code_review_comments: In preview only, the dev error overlay (data-emergent-overlay-host, 'Part of the app failed to load') covers #boot-fallback and catches pointer events when bundle.js fails. Production builds don't have this overlay, so it's not a prod bug. To test the fallback buttons in preview, remove the overlay host first.

FlightTracker.cs: if NAVDECK Link starts while the aircraft is airborne, it stays in Parked forever (Parked only moves on OnGround && GS>3). Consider starting in Airborne when !OnGround at first sample. Also, GS jitter at spawn above 3 kt can fire a false 'off'. Consider requiring the parking brake to be released, or a sustained GS for a few seconds.
FlightTracker.cs: a bounce or touch-and-go after the first touchdown is ignored, and the landing rate comes from the first ground contact. This is acceptable but worth noting.

Fsuipc7Setup.Install writes FSUIPC7.ini. If FSUIPC7 is installed under Program Files, the write throws UnauthorizedAccessException without admin rights. Make sure MainForm catches it and shows a message.
FSUIPC offsets look correct: 0x0366 on ground, 0x02B4 GS, 0x030C touchdown VS, 0x0BC8 parking brake, 0x126C fuel lb, 0x3D00 title.

The service worker skips /downloads/ and won't cache HTML for script/style requests. Confirmed: the exe is served with Cache-Control no-store and is not in the navdeck-v3 cache. The only cache seen was navdeck-v3.
